purpose: Give the artist one durable Headquarters-level Focus Session contract independent of DAW targeting: choose MAKE, FINISH, MANAGE, RELEASE or PERFORM, optionally bind the focus to the current canonical Song, preserve that focus across Headquarters navigation and application relaunch, switch modes without losing history, and explicitly end focus without mutating unrelated Song, provider, DAW or business state.

lineage.outcome: An artist can tell Headquarters what kind of work deserves attention now and N0TE preserves that intention instead of treating every known task as equally urgent.

n0te2_dependencies: UX-01A landed Artist Headquarters / Now surface
CORE-01 canonical LineageStore and Activity chronology
legacy_rejections: reuse DAW FocusContext for artist attention mode
global mode that crosses Artist profiles
mode switch that deletes prior focus history
fake jobs/suggestions created only to demonstrate attention UX
automatic provider/DAW/business action when focus changes
claim REQ-SCOPE-097 fully closed before Not Now semantics exist

completion_proof: canonical profile persistence contains one active Headquarters Focus Session at most and preserves closed/superseded focus history
supported modes are exactly MAKE, FINISH, MANAGE, RELEASE and PERFORM; invalid or blank modes fail before persistence
a Focus Session may bind only to a Song in the active profile; cross-profile or nonexistent Song references fail closed
starting a new Focus Session transactionally closes the prior active Focus Session before activating the replacement; history is not deleted or rewritten
ending focus is explicit and leaves no active Focus Session while preserving prior history
Focus Session changes append understandable Activity chronology without mutating Song identity/version/assets/evidence/provider/DAW state
Headquarters /now lets a normal consumer choose/switch/end Focus without raw IDs or developer plumbing and shows the active mode plus bound Song title when applicable
active Focus survives Home/Song/Now/Settings navigation and full explicit Quit/relaunch through the same canonical profile
multiple Artist profiles retain isolated Focus histories and never render another profile's active mode or Song binding
DAW FocusContext remains a distinct read-only exact-targeting concept and is not imported, renamed or overloaded by this increment
authored unit/HTTP/consumer smoke proof is kept separate from executed evidence; absent hosted execution remains UNOBSERVED
next_selection_rule: After UX-01B is implemented, red-teamed and landed, re-audit REQ-SCOPE-097 and the NOW/Attention lineage. Implement durable Not Now only against a truthful attention-item lifecycle; do not create fake reminders, release triggers or job objects solely to satisfy the wording.
